howto: Pick a level (Starter, Climb or Pro) and a beat, then press Start Rapping.
A word appears. Type a word that rhymes with it and tap DROP or press Enter.
Answer before the time bar empties. Three misses and the mic drops.
tips: Rhymes end with the same sound: change the first sound and keep the ending.
A fast answer earns a +5 bonus, and your chain adds up to +30 a word.
Pass skips a hard word without losing a heart, but it breaks your chain.
Each word can only be used once per game.
Load your own music as the beat, or slow the built-in beat with the BPM slider.

controls.keyboard: Type your rhyme and press Enter. P or Esc pauses when the text box is not in use.
controls.touch: Tap the text box to type, then tap DROP

difficulty: Three level bands: Starter (short words and extra time, ages 6-7), Climb (starts short and adds longer words as rounds go on, ages 8-9) and Pro (medium and long words from the start, ages 10 and up). The time bar shortens each round.

features.age-or-level-bands: Starter, Climb and Pro levels on the title, each with an age guide
features.hints: The arcade Hint gives the ending a rhyme needs and the first letter of an unused rhyme; a miss shows an example rhyme
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: rhymes tried and accuracy for short, medium and long words, practice days, the words missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first game (the time bar waits); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Mic Drop card with score, best, best chain and rounds
